summary: Accepted the humanoid-robotics and embodied-AI relationship to NVIDIA with medium positive sensitivity and medium confidence. NVIDIA has a direct product channel through simulation, world models, training compute, edge modules, safety tooling and the CUDA ecosystem. Current vendor disclosures do not quantify humanoid-attributable revenue or repeat paid deployment economics, so scale and materiality remain explicit gates; no strategy or follow-up operation was created.

evidence.claim: NVIDIA names major industrial robot makers and humanoid developers integrating its simulation, world-model and edge-compute stack, establishing a product channel without quantified revenue.
NVIDIA describes a robotics safety stack and named partners while identifying safety and certification as gating inputs.
The maintained idea confirms a large conventional robot base but retains low confidence in near-term general-purpose humanoid and supplier economics.

daily_report_items: Accepted NVIDIA's medium-confidence physical-AI edge while retaining paid deployment, safety and revenue materiality as confirmation gates.
